rationale: This is a cosmetic variant of the archived "Knowledge Depreciation Mix" (identical first leg, second leg merely swaps MA for the TREND already used in "Lagged R&D Cash Harvest"), so it recombines two evaluated signals without adding a new mechanism.

Internally consistent and a defensible reframing of the failed intangible-ramp family (ramp rewarded only when cash conversion improves and leverage does not rise), though it overlaps materially with "Knowledge Spend Turnover Discipline" apart from level-vs-change and sales-productivity-vs-cash-margin substitutions.

The TS_MIN R&D floor leg is lifted directly from "Minimum R&D Earnings Persistence," but the replacement quality leg (cash-flow trend minus earnings trend) is a substantively different accrual-quality condition rather than a cosmetic tweak — with the caveat that this leg is close to a trend version of the well-known accruals anomaly.

Sign logic is coherent and the working-capital-scaling condition is a genuinely different conditioner than prior legs, but note it takes the opposite view of net working capital from the archived "Liquidity-Strained R&D Expansion" (which treated falling NWC as the bad state), so the proposal should acknowledge that it is implicitly betting on the accruals interpretation.

Both legs are near-direct rediscoveries of published anomalies (goodwill/asset growth and Sloan accruals expressed as earnings-minus-cash-flow), and it is the third goodwill-deterioration variant after two archived versions already returned t-stats near zero.

The advertising-versus-R&D composition shift conditioned on cash-margin decay is a genuinely new construct with a consistent expected sign, but COALESCE(xad,0) will zero out the advertising delta for the majority of firms that never report xad, collapsing the first leg into a pure negative-ΔR&D term for most of the cross-section — worth restricting to firms with non-missing xad.
